Stray top-level scaffold/contract drop-in (doubled directory name, never wired into any workspace/package). Its own MANIFEST.json/README.md/NEXT_AGENT_PROMPT.md explicitly flagged themselves as 'not a claim these exact repo files are missing' and required a duplication check before use, per this repo's Duplication Prevention rule. Compared against the live codebase file-by-file: contracts/events.ts was ALREADY_EXISTS (sveltekit-frontend/src/lib/server/queue/event-fabric.ts covers the same 6 envelope classes as live Zod schemas, richer than the pack's plain TS types) except WorkCommandV1, which was deliberately NOT ported — the pack's own NEXT_AGENT_PROMPT.md states 'RabbitMQ command queues are not integration-event queues,' so a command envelope does not belong in the event-fabric discriminated union. contracts/merkle.ts's envelope types (AnalyticsMerkleCheckpointV1/CheckpointCommitV1) were also NOT ported as new types for the same reason — event-fabric.ts's checkpointCommitPayloadSchema/CheckpointCommitEventV1 already own that envelope shape; only the genuinely new pieces (RFC-9162 Merkle tree hashing primitives, which nothing in the repo implemented) were ported, adapted to emit the existing CheckpointCommitPayloadV1 shape instead of a competing type. graph-identity.ts (symbolId/symbolVersionId/treeNodeId/graphNodeKey branded identity types) and identity-audit.ts were genuine gaps beneath the repo's existing packet_key/source_ref lineage contract, not duplicates, and were ported as-is with import paths adjusted. kanban-contracts.ts (a priority-scoring formula, not a competing task-board owner — existing atlas/kanban-task-board.ts + db/schema/kanban-tasks.ts own the actual task lifecycle) and parent-atlas-daily-compiler.ts were also genuine gaps, ported with imports rewired onto the existing event-fabric.ts types instead of the pack's own now-archived contracts/events.ts and contracts/merkle.ts. Ported files: sveltekit-frontend/src/lib/server/atlas/merkle/{rfc9162-merkle.ts,node-sha256.ts,checkpoint-builder.ts,rfc9162-merkle.spec.ts}, atlas/identity/graph-identity-contracts.ts, atlas/graph/graph-identity-audit.ts, atlas/daily/{kanban-candidate-scoring.ts,parent-atlas-daily-compiler.ts}. NOT applied: the 3 SQL migration templates (001_integration_event_outbox.sql, 002_analytics_merkle_checkpoints.sql, 003_graph_identity_constraints.sql) — the pack's own README states 'SQL files are templates and must be reconciled with the live schema,' and per this repo's Drizzle Safety Rule, generated/proposed SQL requires manual operator review before being journaled or applied. They remain only in this archive copy, unreviewed and unapplied, pending an explicit reconciliation pass against the live schema.

One of 16 files archived together from the stray top-level src/ directory (predates the 8/2026 branch-merge wave, no package.json/workspace registration, introduced ~May 2026, unrelated to recent merges). All 16 collided by filename with a real, live sveltekit-frontend/src implementation of the same capability and were confirmed via direct read to be thin placeholders (20-line stub vs sveltekit-frontend's 100-line real ace-builder.ts). Sibling entries in this batch: ace-query-packet.ts (20L schema stub vs 213L full impl), feature-envelope.ts (27L vs 601L), graph-retriever.ts (15-line no-op returning [] vs 130L real retriever), okf-schema.ts (18L vs 105L), qdrant-dense-retriever.ts (15-line no-op vs 92L real adapter), ranking-features.ts (26L all-zero placeholder scores vs 120L real scorer), retrieval-candidate.ts (25L vs 202L), token-budget.ts (literal 2-line char/4 estimate vs 68L tokenizer-aware budget), variance-recovery-schema.ts (subset schema, sveltekit-frontend's is a strict superset), classifier-feature-vector.ts (byte-identical duplicate), packet-feature-validator.ts (near-identical, sveltekit-frontend adds `!== undefined` guards root lacks — bugfixed), pagerank-authority-contract.ts (byte-identical duplicate), pagerank-promotion-gate.ts (root still calls isfinite(pagerank_raw), removed in Postgres 18.4 per this repo's own incident note — root is stale/broken; sveltekit-frontend already has the NOT IN ('NaN'::float8,...) fix), ast-keyword-types.ts (47L vs 80L superset), atlas/indexing/domain-classifier.ts (2-line re-export pointing at classifier/domain-classifier.ts, inert). Confirmed root-level tests/cypress/__tests__ that reference top-level src/ are not wired into any CI or test runner (no root package.json test script, no .github/workflows, no cypress.config anywhere) — archiving breaks nothing live. Verified none of these 16 names are imported from top-level src/ into sveltekit-frontend/src/ (grep hits were sveltekit-frontend's own self-references to its own canonical files). Roughly a dozen other collisions in the same directory were found to be genuinely competing real implementations (not stubs) and were deliberately left in place pending manual reconciliation, not archived. MISTAKEN ARCHIVAL, RESTORED SAME SESSION. Root cause: archival verification only checked for cross-tree references (root src/ vs sveltekit-frontend/src/) and never checked whether OTHER root-only files (no sveltekit-frontend duplicate) depend on the archived files internally. Root src/ turned out to be an internally-coherent mini-package (its own contracts/index.ts, retrieval/index.ts, ranking/index.ts, context/index.ts barrel files, enrichers, retrievers, rankers cross-importing each other), not just scattered stray duplicates. Concretely: scripts/atlas/pagerank-authority-demo.mts (a legitimate, manually-runnable, non-CI demo script) imports from src/lib/server/graph/pagerank-authority-contract.ts; that file sits alongside src/lib/server/graph/pagerank-authority-builder.ts (root-only, NO sveltekit-frontend duplicate, never touched by this archival pass), which itself internally imports ./pagerank-authority-contract.js. Deleting the contract file broke both the demo script and the sibling builder file. A broader re-check found 11 of the 16 archived files had real internal dependents within root src/ itself (ace-builder, ace-query-packet, feature-envelope, graph-retriever, okf-schema, qdrant-dense-retriever, ranking-features, retrieval-candidate, token-budget, pagerank-authority-contract, ast-keyword-types), via barrel index.ts files and direct cross-module imports. User caught the gap by challenging "zero live importers" scope directly. All 16 files restored to their original locations, content unchanged (SHA-256 above still matches current file). Lesson, extending this repo's own prior phase101-parent-atlas-packetizer.js incident note: verifying "nothing imports this from the OTHER tree" is necessary but not sufficient before archiving a file that lives inside a larger, internally-wired tree — must also check whether siblings WITHIN THE SAME TREE depend on it, especially when that tree has its own barrel/index re-export files. Whether root src/ as a whole is scaffold-for-future-integration or dead weight remains an open, undecided question — it is NOT resolved by this correction, only un-broken.
